_meta.purpose: Offline retrieval notes injected into the Llama prompt (grounding). Illustrative engineering notes for NEU-DET hot-rolled steel strip defects - validate with a process/metallurgy engineer before production use.
quality_system_refs: ISO 9001:2015 clause 8.7 - Control of nonconforming outputs
ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2 - Nonconformity and corrective action

crazing.description: Network of fine surface cracks (crazing) on the strip surface.
typical_causes: thermal shock / uneven cooling after rolling
excessive roll surface wear or roll-cooling water imbalance
corrective_actions: check cooling-zone water flow and temperature gradient
inspect work-roll surface condition and schedule a roll change if worn
hold affected coil section for metallurgical sampling

sensor_hints.vibration: vibration bursts alongside crazing suggest roll chatter or unstable strip tension
sensor_hints.current: main-drive current spikes suggest load fluctuation during reduction
sensor_hints.acoustic: acoustic bursts may indicate micro-cracking events

inclusion.description: Non-metallic or foreign material embedded in the surface (inclusions).
typical_causes: slag or refractory carry-over from steelmaking/casting
foreign debris pressed in during rolling
corrective_actions: divert affected section to quarantine for visual/metallographic check
inspect descaler nozzles and filtration upstream of the stand
review tundish/casting cleanliness records for the heat

sensor_hints.vibration: impact-type vibration can accompany debris passing through the roll bite
sensor_hints.acoustic: acoustic transients are consistent with foreign particles in the bite
sensor_hints.current: short current spikes can occur when hard particles enter the bite

patches.description: Irregular discoloured or oxidised patches on the surface.
typical_causes: uneven scale formation or oxidation during reheating/cooling
non-uniform pickling or chemical bath concentration
corrective_actions: check reheat furnace atmosphere and soak uniformity
verify pickling/chemical bath concentration, temperature and agitation
inspect cooling-water nozzles for blockage

sensor_hints.vibration: vibration is usually not related to patches; check machine health separately
sensor_hints.acoustic: acoustic activity is usually unrelated to patches
sensor_hints.current: no direct link; treat sensor anomalies as a separate machine-health issue

pitted_surface.description: Small pits or craters distributed over the surface.
typical_causes: scale pressed into the surface and later removed
corrective_actions: increase/verify descaling pressure and nozzle alignment
inspect work rolls for pitting and replace if needed
review upstream descaling and reheat practice

sensor_hints.vibration: periodic vibration may point to a damaged roll surface
sensor_hints.acoustic: acoustic ticks can accompany roll surface damage
sensor_hints.current: load fluctuation can accompany roll damage

rolled-in_scale.description: Scale rolled into the strip surface forming dark streaks or patches.
typical_causes: incomplete descaling before the roughing/finishing stand
low descaler water pressure or blocked nozzles
excessive scale growth from long exposure at high temperature
corrective_actions: verify descaler pressure and clean/replace blocked nozzles
reduce residence time between furnace and first stand
inspect strip upstream of the affected stand

sensor_hints.vibration: vibration bursts can occur when hard scale enters the roll bite
sensor_hints.acoustic: acoustic bursts are consistent with scale fragmentation in the bite
sensor_hints.current: current spikes suggest increased roll load from scale

scratches.description: Linear scratches along or across the rolling direction.
typical_causes: misaligned or worn guide rollers and entry/exit guides
foreign particles dragged along the strip
corrective_actions: inspect and realign guide rollers and strip guides
check guide surfaces for burrs or debris
verify roll speed synchronisation

sensor_hints.vibration: vibration bursts support guide or roller misalignment
sensor_hints.current: current spikes can indicate drag or binding

machine_only.description: Machine-health anomaly (spikes) with no visual defect detected.
corrective_actions: inspect bearings, guide rollers and drive for the flagged channel
log the event and re-inspect the next sections visually
escalate to maintenance if the anomaly persists across consecutive windows
